headline: Two years ago today, the world lost Rich Homie Quan 🕊️ From “Type of Way” and “Lifestyle”
body: Two years ago today, the world lost Rich Homie Quan 🕊️ From “Type of Way” and “Lifestyle” to “Flex,” his music helped define an unforgettable era of Atlanta rap and still lives on today. Forever RHQ 🙏💙
